response.markdown_report:
At 0% progress, prioritize a small, testable extension: an ordered title encoder trained jointly with the corrected HSTU. No new validation improvement is claimed.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) User feedback distinguishes broad relatedness from specific usefulness. Item text can expose finer distinctions, but cannot establish purchase intent. (2) Electronics has a 10.71% negative-over-positive rate and a −0.0749 tenth-percentile margin. These sampled diagnostics motivate discrimination experiments, not conclusions about held-out ranking. (3) Collapse scores near 0.5 imply approximately zero mean cosine similarity. An anti-collapse intervention therefore lacks supporting evidence.

**Insights from related work.** (1) HSTU supports gated representations and relative attention bias [1]. Keeping its backbone isolates a small representation change. (2) Character CNNs learn ordered local patterns without pretrained weights [2]. They motivate preserving model numbers and connector punctuation, although pooled features cannot guarantee compatibility. (3) MARS motivates attribute-aware matching [3]. Its pretrained-language-model recipe cannot be transferred directly under these constraints.

**Framework and directions.** Organize interventions by where specificity enters: item representation → ordered text residual; history selection → relative-position decay; optimization → normalized sampled softmax. The gap is whether observable details improve ranking beyond ID associations without introducing independent predictors.

Scores below are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty, each 0–10; higher difficulty means harder implementation. Each assessment gives a positive and a limitation in that order.

| Atomic idea | Scores | Critical assessment across the five axes |
|---|---|---|
| Ordered title residual [2,3] | 5/7/8/7/5 | Originality: constrained integration; established encoder. Potential: reusable specificity features; sparse titles. User: targets broad matches and format mismatches; cannot prove compatibility. Model: tests Electronics confusion; gains uncertain. Difficulty: small module; deployment parity requires care. |
| Learned per-head position decay [1] | 3/6/6/5/3 | Originality: adaptive bias; familiar mechanism. Potential: recent-intent modeling; may suppress enduring interests. User: targets stale associations; cannot infer fulfilled needs. Model: may reduce confusing context; indirect evidence. Difficulty: few parameters; attention masking needs verification. |
| Normalized 128-negative softmax [1] | 2/6/4/8/4 | Originality: reproducible control; established recipe. Potential: stronger discrimination; temperature sensitivity. User: may improve top ranks; no explicit attribute signal. Model: directly targets margins; sampled margins can mislead. Difficulty: conventional loss; extra scoring cost. |

**Selected experiment.** Replace the prior inspiration’s unordered text pooling with a small ordered title encoder, while retaining the corrected baseline objective, sampler and optimizer. This explicitly targets broad thematic substitutions and overlooked format/connector distinctions; it also tests Electronics’ measured ranking confusion. It does not claim to resolve fulfilled needs.

Encode punctuation-preserving title tokens with width-2/3 convolutions and masked positional pooling. Project into item space and add a sigmoid-gated residual initialized near zero; tie history and candidate representations. Train one HSTU per category, select only by fixed macro validation HR@10, and compare with the corrected baseline. Preserve seeds, budgets, diagnostics, routing and predictor parity.

References: [1] https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17152 ; [2] https://arxiv.org/abs/1509.01626 ; [3] https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.00702

idea.description: Add one small, jointly trained, order-sensitive title encoder to each corrected HSTU category model. Fuse its output into the item representation through a gate initialized near zero, using the same representation for history inputs and candidate scoring. Keep the baseline loss and sampling unchanged to isolate the representation intervention.
idea.motivation: The selected idea explicitly addresses two observed user failures: broad thematic matches replacing specific preferences, and recommendations overlooking format or connector distinctions. It also targets the measured Electronics negative-over-positive rate of 10.71%, tenth-percentile margin of -0.0749, and small-margin rate of 16.36%. These observations motivate a hypothesis; neither improved compatibility nor improved validation HR@10 has been demonstrated. The prior inspiration used unordered text pooling plus several objective and sampling changes; this proposal isolates ordered title features as a smaller first experiment.
idea.implementation_notes:
Extend the supplied corrected HSTU rather than replacing its backbone. Keep its architecture dimensions, optimizer, loss, sampling, validation schedule and checkpoint rule fixed for the first comparison. Train exactly one independent network per category, with all four required routes. No independent text predictor, score fusion, checkpoint averaging or separately fitted popularity/transition component is permitted.

Use only supplied public titles for this experiment. Build a deterministic vocabulary from permitted title metadata with lowercase tokenization that preserves digits, decimal points, hyphens, slashes and token order. Reserve padding and unknown tokens; save the tokenizer, vocabulary and per-item token tensors. Proposed defaults are 32 title tokens, 32-dimensional randomly initialized token embeddings, and width-2/3 convolutions with 32 output channels each. Do not download pretrained weights. Empty or missing titles must produce a zero residual.

Mask convolution windows containing padding. Apply max pooling separately over four contiguous token-position bins, defined from the actual title length, then concatenate and project to the HSTU item dimension. Empty bins return zero. This retains coarse order while keeping the module small; it does not reliably represent arbitrary connector direction, number-unit bindings or physical compatibility. Set e(i)=item_emb(i)+sigmoid(g)*LayerNorm(project(text_encoder(title_i))), with g initialized to -3. Force e(0)=0. Use e(i) for both sequence inputs and candidate scoring, preserving the baseline scoring function otherwise. Text features are internal layers of the single model and receive gradients only through its recommendation loss.

Keep item_emb as the ID embedding module for the ModelView compatibility contract. Expose joint vectors through the actual model and make predict_score use them. Preserve log2feats(sequence), the family-specific sample_batch, and the diagnosis loader tuple (None, sequence, positive, negative). DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis) must retain their interfaces. Operational margins must use predict_score; distinguish raw-ID embedding similarity from joint-vector similarity. Leave unsupported metadata breakdowns unavailable. A mapped cosine score near 0.5 is not evidence of substantial directional collapse.

Use preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per executed epoch. DATA_DIR remains os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; save artifacts beneath the trial directory. Retain supplied splits and the pinned evaluator: 200 validation users per category, 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed 42. Select using macro validation HR@10, not Electronics diagnostics. All training and diagnostics count against the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Do not access test labels, hidden files, other trials or external datasets.

For left-padded histories, read the maximum position index with a nonzero item, never nonpadding_count-1. Handle empty histories using the corrected baseline convention. Save one selected checkpoint per category containing model parameters, architecture configuration and title assets. Update the embedded predictor writer with the identical encoder, fusion and scoring implementation. In evaluation mode, verify training-model and reloaded-predictor scores agree on permitted examples before accepting the trial. Any cached text vectors must be computed from that same selected checkpoint after training.

Report all attempted trials and actual validation results. If budget permits, a separately retrained shuffled-title control can test whether item-specific text matters; it must not be combined with the selected model at inference. Avoid attributing any validation gain to compatibility without additional measured user evidence.
idea.pseudocode:
For each of the four supplied category routes:
    Reset training RNGs to 42; retain preprocessing seed 0 and supplied splits.
    Load the corrected category-specific HSTU baseline and permitted titles.
    Build deterministic title vocabulary, token tensors and missing-title masks.
    Add a randomly initialized token CNN with masked four-bin positional pooling.
    Define joint_item(i):
        if i is padding or title is missing: return baseline item embedding
        residual = LayerNorm(project(title_encoder(title_tokens[i])))
        return item_emb(i) + sigmoid(g) * residual
    Use joint_item for sequence inputs and candidate scoring.
    For each configured epoch, capped at 200:
        For exactly 200 batches:
            Sample causal examples with the supplied family-specific sampler.
            Compute HSTU features and the unchanged baseline objective.
            Update all parameters jointly using the baseline optimizer.
        Validate at the unchanged schedule using the pinned protocol.
        Apply the baseline checkpoint rule and account for GPU time.
    Save one selected checkpoint, configuration and title assets.
    Run family-compatible diagnosis using operational predict_score margins.
Write working/predict.py with the identical architecture and four-category routing.
For inference:
    Load exactly one trained checkpoint for the requested category.
    Compute log2feats(left_padded_sequence).
    Gather the final nonpadding position; handle empty input explicitly.
    Score candidates through the model's single predict_score function.
Verify reloaded score parity; report only measured validation results.

originality.positive: A controlled extension of the previous unordered text residual tests whether local order and coarse title position improve specificity within one HSTU.
originality.negative: Convolutional text encoders, positional pooling and gated residual fusion are established components; no fundamental architectural novelty is claimed.

future_potential.positive: Provides a feasible route to test observable item specificity without pretrained weights, independent predictors or major HSTU changes.
future_potential.negative: Sparse titles and weak interaction supervision may encourage brand shortcuts; sampled HR@10 improvements would not establish physical compatibility or fulfilled-need awareness.

code_difficulty.positive: The added encoder is small and leaves the baseline objective, sampler and HSTU blocks intact.
code_difficulty.negative: Padding-safe convolutions, tied joint representations, diagnostic adaptation and exact predictor/checkpoint parity require careful implementation.

related_work.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
contributions: Introduces HSTU, the required sequential backbone, with pointwise attention and multiplicative gating.
Provides a basis for preserving the model family while testing small internal representation changes.
limitations: Does not establish that the proposed title encoder improves these four Amazon categories.
Its published results do not substitute for the pinned macro validation HR@10 evaluation.

related_work.title: Character-level Convolutional Networks for Text Classification
contributions: Demonstrates learning local ordered text patterns with convolutional encoders trained from scratch.
Provides architectural motivation for compact text feature extraction without pretrained weights.
limitations: Studies text classification rather than sequential recommendation.
The proposed token CNN is an adaptation; local convolution and pooling do not guarantee compatibility reasoning.

related_work.title: MARS — attribute-aware recommendation reference supplied in the search results
contributions: Motivates representing item attributes more explicitly when matching user interests.
Supports investigating finer item details beyond broad historical associations.
limitations: Uses pretrained language models according to the supplied search summary, making its full recipe unsuitable here.
Provides no direct evidence for gains from the proposed from-scratch HSTU title encoder.
